samples.gvd:
module up_down_counter (
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire up_down,
    output reg [15:0] count
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        count <= 16'b0;
    end else begin
        if (up_down) begin
            count <= count + 1;
        end else begin
            count <= count - 1;
        end
    end
end

endmodule

        <input id="up_down">Control signal (1-bit).</input>
        <output id="count" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit output representing the current counter value.</output>
    </ports>

        Sequential logic to implement the counter.
    </implementation>
</module>
